title: Conjunction of function testers
statement: Given two nonadaptive testers with the same domain and codomain, making $r$ and $s$ queries respectively, define a tester making $r+s$ queries. It samples a seed from each tester according to their respective laws, independently, concatenates their query lists, and accepts exactly when both testers accept the corresponding blocks of answers.
